narrative.details:
Orokk is not crying, adventurer. Soot is in eye.

<Orokk wipes a tear away.>

There is one last Omosh family secret Orokk will teach you. Orokk will die happy, thanks to adventurer.

Learn Omosh dance of joy and then you learn fist of iron!
narrative.objectives: Watch and learn the Omosh Dance of Joy.
narrative.offerRewardText:
<Orokk pants.>

It has been a very long time since Orokk has done the Omosh dance of joy. Learn now, adventurer!

chain.subtitle: 5 quests from level 32 to 36, 10,980 XP in all.

quests.objectiveText: Bring two Solid Iron Mauls, two Silvered Bronze Boots, and two Silvered Bronze Gauntlets to Orokk Omosh in Orgrimmar.
